initialHarnessFailures.cause: The harness used an incorrect BOE contest ID. Corrected to the actual persisted ID including member.

limitations: Auxiliary authorities not loaded into this replay remain unavailable and show the app existing gap behavior. This is a real-data read-only local rendering proof, not evidence that production has published these changes.

tomorrow.scope: Controlled-clock actual page render using the unchanged CA payload proven by the normal next-day publisher replay; no production writes or future waiting.

browser.method: Actual rendered app page SSR HTML, with the currently built app CSS. Served by Playwright route fulfillment from memory at a loopback URL; no database or server mutation. Client hydration and out-of-replay auxiliary authorities are not included.
